Room.title: Multiplayer Classroom Room
Room.description: The shared table of a 4-letter QR multiplayer classroom room: only what every student's phone shows anyway (never bets or hints).

locked.description: Whether new student joins are locked

hostUid.description: Firebase id of the device hosting the room

rev.description: Revision of the latest host update

tableJson.description: JSON-encoded shared part of the player views (round, sentence, peers, revealed results)

seatRevs.description: Map of playerId to the revision of that player's latest seat record

RoomSeat.title: Private Student Seat Record
RoomSeat.description: One student's private part of the view (their bet, hints, power-ups) and the answer to their join request. Readable only by that phone's Firebase id and the host.

uid.description: Firebase id of the student's phone

playerId.description: Player id of the seat, once given

viewJson.description: JSON-encoded private part of the player's view

joinJson.description: JSON-encoded answer to the latest join request

rev.description: Revision of the host update that wrote this record

RoomIntent.title: Student Room Intent
RoomIntent.description: Per-student join request or betting/power-up action sent to the Host table.

uid.description: Firebase id of the student's phone

CloudRoster.title: Classroom Roster
CloudRoster.description: Saved classroom student roster with names, avatars, and bankrolls for Fresh Start or Tournament Resume.

notes.description: Optional class notes or period label

startingCash.description: Default starting stack for this class

playersJson.description: JSON-encoded array of roster players (name, avatar, money, winStreak)

playerCount.description: Number of students in the roster

updatedBy.description: Teacher identifier (Google email or Teacher PIN)

SessionReport.title: Classroom Session Report & Cloud Save
SessionReport.description: Saved game session report card and optional resumable full game state.

playerCount.description: Number of players at the table

fullGameStateJson.description: Optional JSON-encoded full game state for resuming mid-game

CuratedSentence.title: Cloud Curated Sentence
CuratedSentence.description: Verified AI-generated grammar challenge archived to the shared Cloud Sentence Bank.

isCorrect.description: Whether sentence is grammatically valid (binary mode)

grammarPhrase.description: Target grammar phrase for Grammar Goggles

acceptedAnswers.description: Accepted single-word answers for open cloze

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Active multiplayer classroom rooms indexed by 4-letter room code

/rooms/{roomCode}/seats/{clientId}.description: Each student's private seat record (own bet, hints, join answer)

/rooms/{roomCode}/intents/{clientId}.description: Individual student join requests and game intents

/rosters/{rosterId}.description: Saved classroom rosters for Fresh Start or Tournament Resume

/session_reports/{reportId}.description: Saved classroom game reports and resumable table states

/curated_sentences/{sentenceId}.description: Auto-growing cloud bank of AI-generated grammar sentences
